welcome.title: Films, cinema tickets and more — in one place
welcome.lede: Rent films, watch everything with Watching PRO, and book cinema seats — all in one place.
welcome.price: Joining is free. Rent the films you want — or, if you like, watch them all with Watching PRO.
welcome.ready: Ready to watch? Enter your e-mail to create a free account.
welcome.a.what: WatchingYou brings film rentals, the Watching PRO subscription and cinema tickets together. Watch at home, pick a showing and book your seats, and meet other film lovers from around the world.
welcome.a.cost: An account is free. Rent any film for 3 days for $0.50; when they are up, keep it 3 more days for $0.50 or return it. Watching PRO is $5 a month for unlimited viewing of every film.
welcome.a.where: On your computer, tablet or phone — in any browser. There is also the WatchingYou app for cinema tickets, whose QR codes open even offline.
welcome.a.cancel: There is nothing to cancel: Watching PRO never renews by itself and your card is not kept. When the month is over, pay again if you want more — or simply do nothing.
welcome.a.watch: A catalogue of films across genres, plus short films sent in by their makers. New titles are added regularly.
welcome.q.cinema: How do I buy a cinema ticket?
welcome.a.cinema: Open “Cinema seats”, choose a showing and your seats, and pay by card — the ticket with its QR code arrives in your account and inbox at once.
welcome.q.language: Why am I seeing this language?
welcome.a.language: It was chosen from your browser's language settings. Switch between Azerbaijani, English, Russian and Turkish from the menu at the top right.

welcome.planFreeNote: Free account: rent any film you want, no subscription needed.
welcome.planProNote: Optional: every film, unlimited, no automatic charges.
